ops.spec: Creates a Task inside the given Project. The new Task is not done. Supplying a recurrenceRule creates a RecurringTask instead of a plain Task; omitting it creates a plain Task. Supplying a priority sets it; omitting it leaves the Task at normal.

tests: createTask with priority high yields a Task at high priority
createTask without a priority yields a Task at normal
createTask with a priority outside low/normal/high is rejected
